resources.name: Alkali halide material parameters (r0, ionic radii, TKS polarizabilities) from Kittel 1968

access.notes: Values available in Kittel, C. 'Introduction to Solid State Physics', 1968, pp. 98, 105, 385. The solver is expected to extract and hardcode the required numbers.

resources.notes: Includes r0 (cation-anion separation), ionic radii, and T.K.S. polarizabilities for the 16 alkali halides (LiF, LiCl, LiBr, LiI, NaF, NaCl, NaBr, NaI, KF, KCl, KBr, KI, RbF, RbCl, RbBr, RbI).

resources.name: Python programming environment with numerical capabilities

access.notes: Standard open-source packages. The agent may use any language or tools; Python is suggested for convenience.
